name: crime_census
description: Test 2. bucket = trunc(f32(EQ x 0.02f)) with 0.02f = 0.0199999995529651641845703125 and the product rounded to float32 once (foundations 18, 24-bit x87). Per foundations 18; crime.md 6.1/test 2 text still shows the pre-18 values (EQ 50 -> 0, 100 -> 1, 150 -> 2, 200 -> 3). By hand: 49.99 -> 0.9998 -> 0; 50 -> 0.99999997765 rounds to 1.0f -> 1; 50.0000038 (the float above 50) -> 1.00000005 -> 1.0f -> 1; 99.99 -> 1.9998 -> 1; 100 -> 1.99999996 -> 2.0f -> 2; 100.00001 (f32 100.0000076) -> 2; 150 -> 2.99999993 -> 3.0f -> 3; 199.99 -> 3.9998 -> 3; 200 -> 3.99999991 -> 4.0f -> bucket 4, ignored ([choice] buckets outside 0..3 are ignored); 250 -> 5, ignored; -49.9 -> -0.998 -> trunc 0; -50.1 -> -1, ignored. The census run gives each R$ tract a power-of-two population so the bucket sums show where each tract went: b0 = 1 + 2, b1 = 4 + 8 + 16, b2 = 32 + 64, b3 = 128 + 256; 512 (EQ 200) and 1024 (EQ 250) are dropped. R$$$: -49.9 (7) -> b0, -50.1 (9) dropped. A wealth without grids contributes nothing. Values cross-checked with an independent Python model.
